widget_mechanic: Two-thumb slider where one thumb is min and the other is max. Agent must set the value on the correct thumb (max cap vs min floor). Especially error-prone when the UI shows the same $ value in both thumbs' input boxes.
site_imitates: Steam — Asgard's Wrath 2 customer reviews (Playtime filter)

primary_inspiration.instruction: Browse the latest negative reviews from players with over 100 hours of playtime for the game that won the 2023 VR Game of the Year Award.
primary_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [1.4] Wrong values or constraint violation: The agent selected the Playtime filter “Over 1 hour” while the task required reviews from players with over 100 hours (or the closest available high-playtime bucket).
